theme: An open Saturday, with the trip clock ticking.
greeting: A quiet Saturday in St. Pete with the girls, Dan — the calendar's clear. The one thing pulling on the day is the pile of Croatia bookings, and tomorrow's 9 AM review with Mike is where they come due.

needsAttention.title: Nautilus Sailing balance still open
needsAttention.detail: QuickBooks has sent invoice 2170 twice in three days — the Croatia course balance is marked unpaid. Payment options are in the reminder.

needsAttention.title: Sunday review with Mike, 9 AM
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 15-minute board pass with Mike. Several Croatia bookings are sitting overdue — worth arriving knowing which you've closed and which still need an owner.

needsAttention.title: Last Croatia night still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The single Sept 19 night in Cavtat, before the 7:30 AM flight home, has to be booked from dry land before you sail Sept 8. Marked p1 and past due in the trip project.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing gap, Sept 20-22
needsAttention.detail: Two nights in St Pete between the flight back from Croatia and the Tuesday kid pickup are still open — p1, past due.

needsAttention.title: Checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags. Confirm the allowance on Eurowings Discover's own site before Sept 8 — two 55L duffels won't fly as carry-on, and counter fees run high.

flagged.title: Venmo request for mowing
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver requests $50 for the 8/20 mow.

flagged.title: Sitter applications on Care.com
flagged.detail: Several caregivers applied to your posting and one sent a message over the last two days.

flagged.title: Croatia crew intro thread
flagged.detail: Paul, your Nautilus instructor, introduced himself; Mike and another crewmate have already replied.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and receipts — NYT Cooking, FloridaRAMA confirmations.

recipe.title: Squid with Chili and Clams
recipe.why: High summer wants the quick, bright cooking of the coast — squid and clams seared fast while the season's heat is still on.

acts.line: An open Saturday morning in St. Pete with the girls and nothing on the calendar.
FloridaRAMA whenever you head over — the pass is good from 10 to 8.
Tomorrow's 9 AM review with Mike is the only thing on rails; a few overdue Croatia bookings would be good to close before it.
